row: Integrative Sports Chiropractor & BJJ Black Belt

Dr. Jorge is an integrative family & sports chiropractor, functional medicine expert, pastor/minister & a 2nd degree BJJ black belt.   

Dr. J has over 20 years of clinical experience treating sports and work-related injuries and over 15 years of experience teaching martial arts.  Dr. J is looking for like-minded individuals who love the grappling arts and are interested in holistic and conservative approaches to health and wellness.  Since suffering from severe asthma as a child which was never cured by prescription medications, Dr. J became passionate about getting people off of their prescription medications, overcoming drug dependence and addiction through martial arts, diet & herbal therapy, combined with manual chiropractic techniques. He will soon be offering conventional medical services, Acupuncture, & Traditional Chinese Medicine.  

If you are interested in health, wellness, or the combative arts & self-defense, and want to learn more follow us for more informative videos!
